thread:
jon: Heads-up — after the kernel-selection optimizer landed in canary, we've started seeing OOMs on longctx workloads. Rollout paused.

mika: ugh, saw alerts too. which commit? stack traces? :eyes:

jon: landed: 9f3a2b7 -> kernel-router:prefer-mmap-heuristic. Repro on repro-qa longctx (seq 2048). Pod logs show repeated slab allocs until OOM.

sara: preliminary profiler dump shows fragmentation spike. heap growth dominated by small slab allocations from kv_cache::insert_hot_chunk. Not typical.

jon: paste of quick heap snippet:
```
heap: 1.9GB total
  slabs: 1.2GB (63%)
  kv_cache allocations: ~850MB (most in 64-256B buckets)
  longctx sequences: 10 concurrent requests -> linear slab growth
```

mika: CI perf also flagged regression earlier today — ci-bot linked it: https://ci.internal/Perf/7891 (longctx mem test failed).

ci-bot: perf-test/longctx-2048 failed (regression +24% memory). See artifacts: https://ci.internal/artifacts/7891

sara: hypothesis: kernel selection now favors mmap-backed codepath for certain attention kernels which changes allocation pattern (more small, transient allocations instead of reusing heaplets). Combined with a tweak to kv eviction window in the same deploy -> higher frag. Two small changes interacting.

mika: steps to reproduce locally: run repro script with long prompt, 8 concurrent clients.
```bash
# repro.sh
for i in {1..8}; do 
  curl -sS -X POST http://localhost:8080/generate -d '{"prompt":"a" * 1800}' &
done; wait
```
Logs will show slab growth within ~30s.

jon: suggested mitigations: 1) revert kernel-router change (PR #4328) 2) tighten kv_cache eviction window (temporary) 3) gate mmap-prefers behind feature flag. I've opened revert PR for canary.

mika: I can run a focused bisect between 9f3a2b7 and 2b4d1c0 (kv-evict-window) tonight. If the bisect pinpoints an interaction we can craft smaller revert.

sara: also add short-term telemetry: emit kernel_choice + slab_alloc histogram per-request. We need to see correlation with seq-length.

ops-bot: canary revert PR merged to canary (PR #4331). Starting rolling restart on canary cluster now. :white_check_mark:

jon: after revert, canary pods stabilized — no OOMs after 10m under same repro. Looks like revert mitigated.

mika: bisect outcome: interaction confirmed — both changes together spike mem on seq>1024. Will open follow-up with safer kernel heuristics + evict tuning.

sara: next actions: (1) add telemetry + perf test for longctx in CI (2) refine kernel selection to prefer fastpath when kv_cache fragmented > 30% (3) revert-only guarded release until we have mitigations.

jon: logging action items in the incident ticket and tagging release-engineering. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
